analysis: SFMC-REQ-044 requires the SFMC software to maintain a mission log. This is a clear, standard functional software requirement defining data management capability. It uses mandatory language ('shall'), clearly identifies the responsible software system (SFMC), and contains no vague criteria, escape clauses, or ambiguous scope. Detailed log contents and storage criteria are elaborated in subsequent requirements (SFMC-REQ-045 through SFMC-REQ-047). Maintaining a mission log is a general recording/data management function rather than a safety control or hazard mitigation mechanism, so no SWE-184 safety link applies.
summary: SFMC-REQ-044 is a well-formed functional software requirement that clearly obligates the SFMC software to maintain a mission log without writing defects.
